Use TLS/SSL Encryption 243 244 Always enable encryption in production: 245 246 ```go 247 // STARTTLS (port 587) - Recommended 248 config.UseTLS = true 249 250 // SSL/TLS (port 465) 251 config.UseSSL = true 252 ``` 253 254 ### 2. Secure Credential Storage 255 256 Never hardcode credentials. Use environment variables: 257 258 ```go 259 import "os" 260 261 config := &email.Config{ 262 SMTPHost: os.Getenv("SMTP_HOST"), 263 SMTPPort: 587, 264 SMTPUsername: os.Getenv("SMTP_USERNAME"), 265 SMTPPassword: os.Getenv("SMTP_PASSWORD"), 266 FromEmail: os.Getenv("SMTP_FROM_EMAIL"), 267 UseTLS: true, 268 } 269 ``` 270 271 ### 3. Validate and Sanitize Input 276 277 Always validate email addresses and sanitize content: 278 279 ```go 280 // Validate before sending 281 if err := message.Validate(); err != nil { 282 return err 283 } 284 ``` 285 286 ### 5. Implement Rate Limiting 287 288 Prevent abuse by limiting email sending: 289 290 ```go 291 // Example using golang.org/x/time/rate 292 limiter := rate.NewLimiter(rate.Every(time.Second), 10) // 10 emails per second 293 294 if !limiter.Allow() { 295 return errors.New("rate limit exceeded") 296 } 297 ``` 298 299 ### 6. Monitor and Log 300 301 Log email sending activity for security monitoring: 302 303 ```go 304 if err := email.Send(config, message); err != nil { 305 slog.Error("Email send failed", 306 slog.String("recipient", message.To[0]), 307 slog.Any("error", err)) 308 } 309 ``` 310 311 ## Common Ports 312 313 | Port | Protocol | Security | Use Case | 314 The following related but distinct mechanisms were found:
